description.value: Riverfront Pub & Grill is a full-service riverside pub and restaurant in BC's Okanagan/Thompson Interior, known for live entertainment, local craft beers on tap (including Mt. Begbie and Crannog Ale), and Okanagan wines. The venue is family-friendly with an upper patio for summer dining, pool tables, and a rotating calendar of live music, karaoke, comedy, and stunt shows. It actively markets to outdoor recreation enthusiasts of many kinds and sources produce locally and beef from Alberta.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating pub and grill in the BC Interior (Okanagan/Thompson region), with phone 250-838-7261 appearing twice on the page and an explicit 'Yes We Are OPEN Again' notice plus active menu and event listings. OSM provides no phone or address, so the phone was drawn from the website; the website URL matches the OSM url tag. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content, so all required criteria and optional amenities default to null.
concerns: No street address present in OSM tags or anywhere in the fetched website content — exact location unconfirmed beyond coordinates.
Phone number (250-838-7261) sourced from website only; OSM contains no phone tag, so cross-confirmation was not possible.
The 'Yes We Are OPEN Again as of Feb 6th' banner is undated and could be stale, though the overall site content (active menu, upcoming events, DD Rewards program) suggests ongoing operations.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible pub and restaurant confirmed by website content; a useful food and drink stop for touring cyclists passing through the BC Interior.
enrichment_extras.notes: Site navigation includes 'Rider Links' and 'Sledder Links', indicating the pub markets primarily to motorized recreation enthusiasts (motorcyclists/ATVers and snowmobilers) rather than cyclists specifically. No cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
